target.title: refactor(process): adopt Execa execution layer
target.body:
Closes #105920

## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw's main process-execution wrapper manually coordinated spawn, timeout, abort, output, and close races, while several production call sites bypassed that behavior with raw `node:child_process` calls.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adopts Execa 9.6.1 behind the canonical process wrapper, removes the replaced timer/signal race machinery, and moves descendant-pipe draining into `src/process/child-process.ts`. OpenClaw still owns its security and platform contracts: argv-only execution, `.cmd`/`.bat` handling for CVE-2024-27980, Windows console-codepage decoding, environment normalization, process-tree termination, and capped output capture.

The first migration batch routes agent session exec plus bash/find/grep helpers through the wrapper. The command queue remains unchanged.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Process execution now has one better-tested lifecycle path, with consistent timeout, abort, environment, output-limit, and descendant-pipe handling across the migrated surfaces.

## Evidence

- Exact branch head: `005c918fc45`; exact Testbox base: `8809848b199`.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxctg6r627nyd69mfbnpd59w`: [run 29223158025](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29223158025).
- Execa resolved as 9.6.1 on the proof host.
- `pnpm test src/process src/agents/sessions/exec.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/bash.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/find.fd.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/grep.stream-errors.test.ts` — 15 files, 163 tests passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` and `pnpm tsgo:core:test` — passed.
- `pnpm deps:root-ownership:check`, `pnpm deps:shrinkwrap:check`, and `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` — passed.
- `pnpm build` — passed on the equivalent pre-rebase tree in Testbox [run 29222761404](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29222761404).
- `node scripts/run-oxlint-shards.mjs --threads=8` — zero warnings/errors.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base 8809848b19995e93b4f4713b88ea51f92143b788` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings.

Known upstream gate gap: latest `main` currently has stale global TypeScript LOC-baseline entries across untouched files. This PR's owned entry is ratcheted from 773 to 713 and matches the file's actual 713 lines.

No changelog entry: internal execution-layer refactor with no intended user-visible behavior change.
